confirmedAndFixed.defect: Cold-DDL fixture startup competes with bounded PlatformSettings upsert.
confirmedAndFixed.reproduction: Sequential backend run: Candidate Discovery failed before its first subtest with MongoOperationTimeoutError in findOneAndUpdate during startup; settings synchronization preceded fixture model initialization.
confirmedAndFixed.fix: Register production routes before fixture setup. In disposable-only fixture modules, disable import-time autoCreate/autoIndex, explicitly create the existing schema collections/indexes after connection, then start bounded settings reads. Production defaults, fail-closed behavior, schemas and query timeouts unchanged.
confirmedAndFixed.validation: Final isolated integrity fixture: 3/3; final isolated discovery: 8/8. Existing lifecycle after import cleanup: 5/5. No app query deadline increased.
confirmedAndFixed.additionalReproduction: Final cleanup rerun exposed model.createCollection connection-buffer timeout before a slow disposable connection was ready. Explicit post-connect DDL in ApplicationPerformanceFixture and CandidateDiscovery fixture removes that import-time race.
